facts.fact: The World Bank appraisal document of 14 April 2025 states that the project will support the design and deployment of a centralised digital platform for student management and monitoring, with a smartphone application for data collection at school level and a web interface for the central administration; it is still to be designed and no school is said to use it.
The appraisal document describes the student management platform as a future deployment under a project for pre-primary and primary education, and reports it in use at no level at 14 April 2025.

The appraisal document calls the planned platform a key step towards complete digitisation of student records, and states that key education data and information are currently stored mainly as hard copies; no date is given, so the document's date is used.

The appraisal document names the Ministry of Basic Education (MEBAPLN) as implementing agency of the project that will build the student management platform, which is to be the student management module of the Education Management Information System.

The appraisal document places the student management platform under Component 3 of the project (US$42.7 million: US$17.7 million IDA and US$25.0 million GPE), within a US$203.1 million operation financed by IDA and the GPE fund; it names no domestic budget line for the platform.

The hard-copies statement sits under emergency response (subcomponent 2.1).
